title: tACS for Neuropathic Pain Management After SCI
official: tACS Brain Neuromodulation for Sensory and Motor Recovery After Neurological Impairments
summary: The overall goal is to investigate the effectiveness of a novel intervention - transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) for neuropathic pain management in people after spinal cord injury.
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston

sites.f: The University of Texas Health Science Center
